title: Can a Normal Person Afford a Ferrari SF90?
description:
Could a normal person ever afford a Ferrari SF90? The sticker price is more than half a million dollars. But the sticker price is only the beginning. There is insurance, maintenance, tires, options, a battery that Ferrari plans to replace, and one number that surprises almost everyone. Today we do the math, using real published figures. Here is a hint about the surprise. One of the most expensive parts of owning many supercars is how much value they lose. And for the SF90, that number looks very different from what most people expect. We will get to it.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
